title: Labels
description: The labels on every container a run starts. `corpus` is the checkout the run belongs to, so two checkouts of one repository never remove each other's containers.

corpus.description: The first twelve hex digits of a hash of the checkout path.

entry.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, opening on a letter or a digit; a directory name and half a container name before it is anything else. `corpus` is reserved for the register's header and `reports` for the lifted run reports.
